r_operation_notes.proof: Proof: by the R-operation, K G = -Delta(G) - K sum_S Delta(S) G/S for any 4-loop single-scale (all lines of mass m) vacuum integral G with polynomial numerators; the counterterms Delta are polynomials in m² with pole coefficients in multiple zeta values (infrared rearrangement onto massless propagators of <= 3 loops), and the quotients G/S (<= 3 loops) enter only through ε^(3-L_q) (3L ε⁰, 2L ε¹, 1L ε²), all S (polylogarithms at sixth roots of unity, no 4L constant). So every pole coefficient of G is free of the 4L constants; vakint's exact assembly shows the coefficient of each one to be identically zero (exact rational arithmetic) on every record checked
r_operation_notes.evidence: Verified exactly (coefficient of every 4L/constants.json constant at ε⁻⁴..ε⁻¹ = 0): all 286527 records of the shipped 4L caches (77724 with spurious poles, 1375 with 1/ε²), 2230 sampled keys of track LL and 514 fresh keys outside both (all four families, up to 6 dots and 4 numerator powers); 338832 pole x constant products cancel. The spurious-pole residue vectors span dimension x 6, h 5, bmw 5, fg 3 and every basis vector has zero 4L-constant content. vakint itself returns these orders beyond 20000 digits (4L/P15 + dot: ε⁻¹ to 20524 d in Symbolic, 20499 d of 20500 requested in Numerical mode; finite inputs P15, P17, P18 + dot: exact 0)

names.convention: Loop integrals (Euclidean, unit masses; every propagator 1/(q_e^2 + 1)^{a_e}; measure prod_l d^D k_l / pi^{D/2}; X_hat(delta) = e^{4 gamma_E delta} x integral in D = 2 - 2 delta; PRnD2EpsJ = [delta^J] X_hat; PRnD2 = X_hat(0); PR14epJ = [eps^J] of (-1)^{sum a} e^{4 gamma_E eps} x integral in D = 4 - 2 eps):

method.title: Closed forms
method.text: 1L-3L and the poles of 4L: closed forms from the literature and the MATAD/FMFT expansions (harmonic polylogarithms at the sixth root of unity, the MATAD constants), carried exactly by vakint. 4L finite parts: exact in 50 lifted four-loop constants (Bessel moments, two-dimensional ε-jets) computed to 2348-20000 digits (S*). Some S rows rest on numerical identities of the constant basis checked to thousands of digits (8 identities; PRECISION-TABLES.md).

method.title: Five loops
method.text: Structural zeros from the UV forest bound and exact rows from pole cancellation; 196 of the 591 exact 5L orders are PSLQ identifications (9 S*) and 4 measured zeros, each passing the 40-excess-digit bar (numerical identifications, not proofs). The other 5L orders are numerical (high-precision grids and dispersive gluing; digits = validated significant digits).

method.title: R operation (preview)
method.text: Pole coefficient K G = (A) − Δ: part (A) = −K Σ_S Δ(S) G/S from the subdivergences (ordinary massive R operation, exact, lower-loop coefficients of vakint); Δ = overall counterterm, a pure number. Evidence classes: exact derivation (ω < 0: no overall counterterm, the result is complete); confirmed by R* (Δ derived by R*); fitted counterterm (Δ found as an integer relation of [numeric − (A)] in 1, ζ3, π⁴, ζ5, π⁶, ζ3², ζ7, ζ3π⁴, with its margin in digits). Fits below the acceptance margin are listed as marginal and not applied; poles whose Δ the fit did not identify, or without a part (A) yet, stay numerical and are listed.

method.title: 4L poles
method.text: From ε^-1 down the 4L result is exact and guaranteed: by the R-operation its pole coefficients are free of the 4L-only constants, verified exactly on vakint’s reduction data (footnote 2).

method.title: Numerical check
method.text: Every symbolic form is compared with the numerical value it replaces, to that value’s claimed digits (user ruling 2026-11-10), at adoption and again when the release tooling integrates it; a mismatch blocks the substitution. Published digits of numerical values are the claim minus one digit (user ruling 2026-11-11), so discrepancies of up to one digit are absorbed; larger ones are flagged and listed.
